label: Moments of a transfer function
subgoals: Expand the transfer function in powers of s
Sum shared resistance times capacitance for the first moment
Read minus m1 as the mean of the impulse response

label: The second moment
subgoals: Compute the first moment at every node
Weight each capacitor by its own first moment
Sum shared resistance times weighted capacitance for m2

label: Spread of the impulse response
subgoals: Write the second raw moment as twice m2
Subtract the squared first moment to get the variance
Take the square root to get the spread in picoseconds
